scope: Preparation de diagnostics et de calculs M64 turbo 4V; ni execution distante ni qualification de culasse

budget.enforcement: Existing approved OpenBao wrapper and external lifecycle watchdog; this preparation file does not enforce billing

jobs.purpose: CAD functional reconstruction contract and boundary-frozen local tetrahedral mesh optimization
jobs.reference: Existing OCCT/PicoGK master unchanged; native OpenFOAM14 checkMesh
jobs.gpu_candidate: MFEM 4.10 TMOP CUDA; PhysicsNeMo cross-product adapter for surface diagnostics only
jobs.acceptance: No contour change, no new defects; partial quality gain remains diagnostic; all native failed families must clear before mesh admission

jobs.purpose: Actual four-stroke cycle with moving piston and four valves, valvetrain dynamics and gas exchange; not animation alone
jobs.reference: M64-specific kinematics and multibody contacts; Cantera reduced cycle then qualified OpenFOAM moving-mesh engine case
jobs.gpu_candidate: PhysicsNeMo only as a later surrogate trained on accepted held-out physical cases; no assumed full GPU engineFoam port
jobs.acceptance: Prescribed motion is kinematics only; dynamics requires contact and spring force balance. Full 720-degree cycle plus periodicity and conservation required; animation, one partial cycle or Cantera 0D alone are not full-head validation

jobs.purpose: Conjugate air-solid heat transfer; oil branch only with defined supply, return and pressure losses
jobs.reference: OpenFOAM CPU, actual solver version and case to qualify
jobs.gpu_candidate: OpenCFD GPU development branch or matrix offload only after exact CHT witness; SPUMA paper excludes heat transfer
jobs.acceptance: Predeclare conservation and discretization budgets per load case; no temperature limiter accepted as physical validation

jobs.purpose: Hot preload, pressure, contacts, thermal distortion and thermomechanical fatigue
jobs.reference: CalculiX CPU; independent elastic witness before nonlinear contact and fatigue
jobs.gpu_candidate: MFEM ex2p elastic assembled/Hypre witness only, not an interchangeable full contact/fatigue solver
jobs.acceptance: Equilibrium, mapping and spatial convergence checked; p95 alone does not assess notch singularities or establish service life

jobs.purpose: Isolate F58 laser-source quadrature sensitivity without changing the thermal model
jobs.reference: Pinned additiveFoamF58 AlSi10Mg control coupon, not selected head alloy
jobs.acceptance: Diagnostic completion separate from temperature censoring and physical validity; two quadratures do not establish convergence order

jobs.purpose: Layer activation, supports and build plate, residual stress, release and machining distortion
jobs.reference: Separate part-scale thermomechanical model after coupon qualification
jobs.gpu_candidate: Adamantine pinned source; GO-MELT or HERMES as thermal-only counter-calculation, not three simultaneous ports
jobs.acceptance: No capped coupon used as training truth; global distortion requires process calibration and physical coupon comparison
